metadata.description: Monitor bid-ask spreads for market maker withdrawal patterns near settlement
metadata.note: For historical tracking, run this script periodically. Each run captures a snapshot.

panic_pattern_summary.recommendation: Run this script every 1-2 minutes during the last hour before settlement to detect intra-hour spread widening. The current snapshot captures a single point in time — without time-series data, we can't detect 5-min widening events.
